title: Zaburi
text: Uhoraho ni we Mwungere wanje, nta co nkenye.

title: Yohana
text: Mu ntango ya vyose, Jambo yariho. Uwo Jambo yari kumwe n’Imana, kandi yari Imana.

title: Zaburi
text: Uhoraho ni we muco wanje n’agakiza kanje; none notinya nde? Uhoraho ni igihome kinkingira; none ni nde yontera ubwoba?

title: Yohana
text: Kuko Imana yakunze abari kw’isi cane, bituma itanga Umwana wayo w’ikinege, kugira ngo uwumwizera wese ntazoranduke, ahubwo aronke ubugingo budashira.

title: Zaburi
text: Nimwumvirize mumenye ko Uhoraho ari mwiza; hahiriwe uwumuhungirako.

title: Yohana
text: Nuko Yesu abandanya yigisha ba bantu, ababwira ati: “Jewe ndi umuco w’isi. Uwunkurikira ntazogendera mu mwijima, ahubwo azoronka umuco w’ubugingo.”

title: Zaburi
text: Uhimbarwe n’ Uhoraho , na we azoguha ivyo umutima wawe wipfuza.

title: Filipi
text: Sinkekeranya ko Imana yatanguje ico gikorwa ciza muri mwebwe izokibandanya gushika ikirangije, ku musi Kristo Yesu azogarukirako.

title: Zaburi
text: Imana ni yo buhungiro bwacu n’inkomezi ni umufasha atabura guseruka mu magorwa.

title: Matayo
text: Uko ni ko mukwiye kureka umuco wanyu ukakira imbere y’abantu kugira ngo babone ibikorwa vyanyu vyiza, hanyuma bahimbaze So wo mw’ijuru.

title: Zaburi
text: Igihe cose ngize ubwoba, ni wewe nizigira.

title: Yohana
text: Igisuma ntikizanwa n’ikindi atari ukwiba, ukwica no gutikiza; ariko jewe naje kugira ngo intama zigire ubugingo, kandi zibugire busagutse.

title: Zaburi
text: Utwigishe guharura imisi yacu, kugira ngo turonke imitima y’ubwenge.

title: Roma
text: Ariko, Imana yo yatweretse urukundo rwayo rwinshi mu gutuma Kristo kudupfira kandi tukiri abanyavyaha.

title: Zaburi
text: Mutima wanje, himbaza Uhoraho , ntiwibagire ivyiza yagukoreye vyose;

title: Filipi
text: Ntihakagire ico mukora musunitswe n’ukwikunda canke n’ukwishira hejuru, ariko mu kwicisha bugufi, mushire abandi imbere.

title: Zaburi
text: Uhoraho yabikoze kuri uwu musi nyene; tunezerwe uwu musi kandi duhimbarwe.

title: Imigani
text: Wizigire Uhoraho n’umutima wawe wose, ntiwishimire ugutahura kwawe.

title: Yesaya
text: Uzozigamira mu mahoro yuzuye abo bose bashira ivyiyumviro vyabo kuri wewe, kuko bakwizigiye!

title: Matayo
text: Ahubwo, nimubanze mwitwararike Ubwami bw’Imana no kugororoka kwayo, hanyuma ivyo na vyo izobibaha nk’inyongera.

title: Yohana
text: Ndabahaye icagezwe gishasha: Nimukundane. Nk’uko nabakunze, ni ko namwe mukwiye gukundana.

title: Roma
text: Turazi ko muri vyose Imana ikora ishakira ineza abayikunda, abo yahamagaye nk’uko biri mu mugambi wayo.

title: Efeso
text: Ubuntu bwayo ni bwo bwabakijije ku bw’ukwizera. Kandi n’ivyo ntivyavuye kuri mwebwe, ni ingabire y’Imana.

title: Filipi
text: Mwame munezerewe mu mwami, ndabisubiyemwo ubugira kabiri: nimunezerwe.

title: Abaheburayo
text: Nuko muze twegere intebe y’Imana y’ubuntu dushize amanga, kugira ngo twakire imbabazi, turonke n’ubuntu vyo kudufasha mu gihe gikwiye.

title: Yakobo
text: Bene Data, munezerwe cane, igihe cose muhuye n’ibibagerageza vy’uburyo bwinshi,

title: 1 Yohana
text: Imana ni iyo kwizigirwa kandi iragororotse. Iyo twatuye ivyaha vyacu, irabiduharira ikatweza ibibi vyose.

title: Zaburi
text: Ijambo ryawe ni itara rimurikira ibirenge vyanje, ni umuco umurikira mu nzira yanje.

title: Imigani
text: Uze wegurire Uhoraho ivyo ukora vyose, ni ho ivyawe bizogenda neza.

title: Yesaya
text: ariko abizigiye Uhoraho bazokwama bongerwa inkomezi. Bazoguruka mu kirere nk’abagurukisha amababa y’inkona, bazokwiruka ntibaruhe, bazogenda ntibacike intege.

title: Matayo
text: Musabe muzohabwa, murondere muzoronka, mudodore muzokwugururirwa.

title: Yohana
text: Yesu aramwishura ati: “Ni jewe nzira n’ukuri n’ubugingo. Nta n’umwe ashobora gushika kwa Data atanciyeko.

title: Roma
text: Niwaturisha akanwa kawe ko Yesu ari Umwami, ukizera mu mutima wawe ko Imana yamuzuye mu bapfuye, uzokizwa.

title: 1 Korinto
text: Nta kibagerageza cabashikiye kidashikira abandi. Kandi Imana ni iyo kwizigirwa, ntizobareka ngo mugeragezwe n’ivyo mudashobora kwihanganira. Mu gihe co kugeragezwa, izobacira inzira kugira ngo mushobore kuvyihanganira.

title: 2 Korinto
text: Ni co gituma tudacika intege, naho imibiri yacu iriko irashira, umuntu wacu w’imbere aguma yiyubura ku musi ku musi.

title: Galatiya
text: si jewe nkiriho; ariko ni Kristo ariho muri jewe. Nkiri muri uwu mubiri, mbayeho mu kwizera Umwana w’Imana yankunze akitanga ku bwanje.

title: Efeso
text: Nuko rero iyishobora gukora ibirengeye cane ivyo dusaba canke ivyo twiyumvira, nk’uko ubushobozi bwayo bukorera muri twebwe buri,

title: Filipi
text: Ntimukiganyire ku kintu na kimwe, ariko ivyo mukeneye vyose mubimenyeshe Imana mu gusenga no mu kwinginga, bifatanije no gukenguruka.

title: Abaheburayo
text: Ukwizera ni ukudakekeranya ko ivyo wizigiye bizoba; ni ukutagira amazinda ku vyo utabonesha amaso.

title: Yakobo
text: Nihaba hariho uwo muri mwebwe akeneye ubwenge bw’Imana, akwiye kubusaba Imana, kuko itanga cane kandi ibikunze. Nta we itera imiragwe kuko ayisavye, kandi azobuhabwa.

title: 1 Petero
text: Amashimwe yose abe ay’Imana Se w’Umwami wacu Yesu Kristo, kuko ku bw’imbabazi zayo nyinshi, yaduhaye kuvuka ubwa kabiri, mu kuzura Yesu Kristo mu bapfuye. Ubu dufise ivyizigiro bizima

title: 1 Yohana
text: Nimurabe urukundo Data yadukunze kugeza aho atwita abana biwe! Kandi koko turi bo! Igituma ab’isi batazi ko turi abana n’Imana ni uko batayimenye.

title: Zaburi
text: Ndunamurira amaso yanje ku misozi; ugutabarwa kwanje kuva hehe?

title: Imigani
text: Izina ry’ Uhoraho ni umunara ukomeye; abagororotsi barihungiramwo bakaba amahoro.

title: Yesaya
text: Nuko ntutinye kuko ndi kumwe nawe; ntuhagarike umutima, ndi Imana yawe. Nzogukomeza, nzogutabara, nzokuzigamisha ukuboko kwanje kw’i buryo.

title: Yeremiya
text: Ariko hahiriwe umuntu yizigira Uhoraho , ivyizigiro vyiwe bikaba muri we.

title: Matayo
text: Nimuze kuri jewe mwese abarushe n’abaremerewe n’imitwaro, ndabaruhura.

title: Luka
text: kuko ata jambo Imana ivuze ribura ububasha.”

title: Yohana
text: Jewe ndi umuzabibu; namwe muri amashami. Nimwaguma muri jewe nanje nkaguma muri mwebwe, muzokwama ivyamwa vyinshi. Erega mutari kumwe nanje nta co mushobora gukora!

title: Roma
text: Ntimukigane inyifato n’imigenzo vy’isi ya kino gihe, ariko mureke Imana ibahindure rwose mu kubaha ukwiyumvira gushasha. Aho ni ho muzoshobora gutahura ivyo Imana ibagombako, kuko ni vyo vyiza, ni vyo biyihimbara kandi ni vyo bitunganye rwose.

title: 1 Korinto
text: Urukundo rurihangana, rugira neza, ntirugira ishari, ntirwihayagiza, kandi ntirwishira hejuru.

title: 2 Korinto
text: Kuko uwuri muri Kristo Yesu aba abaye icaremwe gishasha, ivya kera biba biheze, ibishasha biba bishitse.

title: Galatiya
text: Ariko ivyamwa vya Mpwemu Yera ni ibi: urukundo, umunezero, amahoro, ukwihangana, ingeso nziza, kugira neza, ubwizigirwa,

title: Efeso
text: Mugiranire neza kandi mubabarane, mwongere muharirane nk’uko Imana yabahariye muri Kristo.

title: Filipi
text: Nshobozwa vyose na Kristo ampa inkomezi.

title: Kolosayi
text: Ubwenge bwanyu mubushire ku biri mw’ijuru, ntimubushire ku biri mw’isi.

title: 2 Timoteyo
text: Kuko Imana itaduhaye Mpwemu w’ubwoba, ariko yaduhaye Mpwemu w’ububasha, w’urukundo kandi wo kuganza ingeso zacu.

title: Abaheburayo
text: Ni co gituma, ko dukikijwe n’isinzi ry’ivyabona bingana gutyo, dukwiye twiyambura ibituboha vyose bikatubuza kubandanya, hamwe n’icaha kitwizingirako vyoroshe, maze twiruke n’umwete mu rugendo Imana yashize imbere yacu.

title: Yakobo
text: Nuko, mwicishe bugufi imbere y’Imana. Mugwanye wa mubi, na we azobahunga.

title: 1 Petero
text: Ariko mweho muri ubwoko bwatoranijwe, abaherezi b’Umwami, ihanga ryejejwe Imana yiharije, kugira ngo mukwize ishimwe ryayo, yo yabahamagaye ikabakura mu mwijima, ikabazana mu muco wayo utangaje.

title: 1 Yohana
text: Bakundwa, muze dukundane, kuko urukundo ruva ku Mana. Umuntu wese akundana yavyawe n’Imana kandi arayizi.

title: Ivyahishuwe
text: Ehe mpagaze ku muryango ndiko ndadodora. Uwumva ijwi ryanje akugurura umuryango, ndinjira iwe dusangire.

title: Itanguriro
text: Mu ntango, Imana yaremye amajuru n’isi.

title: Gusubiramwo
text: Mushikame, mushire ubwoba. Ntimuzotinye ngo mucike intege kubera ayo mahanga, kuko Uhoraho Imana yanyu azojana namwe. Ntazobaheba, ntazobata.”

title: Yosuwa
text: None si jewe ndakwibaririye nti: Komera ushire ubwoba? Ntutinye, ntucike intege, kuko jewe Uhoraho Imana yawe nzojana nawe aho uzoja hose.”

title: Zaburi
text: Ndaguhimbaza kuko naremwe mu buryo buteye ubwoba kandi butangaje; ivyo ukora biratangaje, ivyo ndabizi neza.

title: Imigani
text: Umenyereze umwana guca mu nzira ibereye, niyakura ntazoyivamwo.

title: Umusiguzi
text: Ikintu cose cashingiwe igihe caco, hari igihe c’igikorwa cose kibera musi y’ijuru:

title: Yesaya
text: Ariko nta kigwanisho cacuriwe kukugwanya kizogira ico kikugira, kandi uzotsinda uwo wese azoguhagurukira ngo akuburanye. Uwo ni wo mugabane w’abasavyi b’ Uhoraho , kandi ni kwo kugororoka kwabo kuva kuri jewe,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.

title: Yeremiya
text: Kuko nzi imigambi ndabafitiye,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “ni imigambi yo kubateza imbere, si iyo kubagirira nabi, ni imigambi yo kubaha ivyizigiro muri kazoza.

title: Intimba
text: Ni uko kubera urukundo ruhambaye rw’ Uhoraho tutazoherengetezwa, kuko imbabazi ziwe zamaho ibihe vyose.

title: Mika
text: Yewe muntu, yarakweretse iciza ico ari co. Mbega hari ikindi Uhoraho akugombako? Ni ugukora ibigororotse, gukunda imbabazi, no kugendana n’Imana yawe wicishije bugufi.

title: Nahumu
text: Uhoraho ni mwiza, ni ubuhungiro mu gihe c’amagorwa, kandi yitaho abamuhungirako.

title: Habakuki
text: Uhoraho Nyeninganji ni we nkomezi zanje; akomeza ibirenge vyanje nk’ivy’ingeregere, anshoboza kugendera ku dutwe tw’imisozi.

title: Zefaniya
text: Uhoraho Imana yawe ari kumwe nawe, ni umuhizi mu ntambara, ashoboye gukiza. Azogira umunezero mwinshi ku bwawe, mu rukundo rwiwe, ntazokwongera kugukankamira, ariko, azokunezererwa akoresheje indirimbo.

title: Malaki
text: Nimuzane ikigiracumi gikwiye mu bubiko bwanje, kugira ngo mu nzu yanje habemwo ivyokurya. Ehe nimubingeragereshe, jewe Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, murabe ko ntugurura imiryango yo mw’ijuru, nkabacuncuburirako imigisha mukabura n’aho muyikwiza.

title: Matayo
text: Nuko nimugende, muhindure amahanga yose abigishwa: mubabatize mw’izina rya Data n’iry’Umwana n’irya Mpwemu Yera,

title: Mariko
text: Ni co gituma ndababwira ko ico muzosaba cose mu gusenga, mukwiye kwizera ko mwamaze kukironka, kandi Imana izokibaha.

title: Luka
text: Mutange, namwe muzohabwa. Ingero nziza, itsindagiye, inyingishe kandi isesekaye ni yo muzogererwa. Kuko ingero mugereramwo abandi ari yo namwe muzogererwamwo.”

title: Yohana
text: Ibi ndabibabwiye kugira ngo mugire amahoro muri jewe. Muri iyi si muzohagirira amarushwa menshi, ariko nimuhumure jewe naranesheje isi.”

title: Ivyakozwe
text: Ariko mwebwe muzohabwa ubushobozi Mpwemu Yera niyabazako; maze muzonshingira intahe i Yerusalemu, i Yudaya n’i Samariya hose, no gushika ku mpera z’isi.”

title: Roma
text: Imana, yo itanga ivyizigiro, ibuzuze umunezero n’amahoro kuko muyizera, kugira ngo murushirize kwizigira amasezerano yayo mubishobojwe na Mpwemu Yera.

title: 1 Korinto
text: None bene Data nkunda, mushikame ntihagire ikibanyiganyiza. Mwiyegurire imisi yose gukorera Umwami wacu kuko muzi neza ko ibikorwa vyanyu atari impfagusa mu Mwami.

title: 2 Korinto
text: ariko anyishura ati: “Ubuntu bwanje buraguhaje, kuko ubushobozi bwanje bukorera muri wewe cane iyo uri mu ntege nke.” Ivyo ni vyo bituma nirata cane intege nke zanje, kugira ngo ubushobozi bwa Kristo bugume kuri jewe.

title: Galatiya
text: Dukore ivyiza tudacika intege, kuko igihe gikwiye kigeze tuzokwimbura, nitutava ku gikorwa.

title: Efeso
text: Ijambo rya nyuma: mukomere mu Mwami wacu no mu bushobozi bwiwe bwinshi.

title: Filipi
text: Imana izobaha ivyo mukeneye vyose nk’uko ubutunzi bw’ubwiza bwayo butangaje buri muri Kristo Yesu.

title: Kolosayi
text: Ivyo mukora vyose muhore mubikorana umutima wanyu wose, nk’aho mwoba muriko mubikorera Umwami wacu, atari abantu,

title: 1 Tesalonike
text: Mwame munezerewe ibihe vyose

title: 1 Timoteyo
text: Ntihagire uwukugaya kubera ukiri muto, ahubwo ubere akarorero abizera: mu mvugo, mu buryo ubayeho, mu rukundo, mu kwizera, no mu kwezwa.

title: 2 Timoteyo
text: Nagwanye intambara nziza, ndarangije urugendo, nazigamye ukwizera.

title: Tito
text: yaradukijije, atari kubera twakoze ibigororotse, ariko kubera imbabazi zayo. Yadukijije mu kutwoza ivyaha vyacu biciye mu kuvuka ubwa kabiri, no mu buzima bushasha bwo muri Mpwemu Yera.

title: Abaheburayo
text: Yesu Kristo ntahinduka: uko yari ari ejo ni ko ari uno musi n’ibihe bidashira.

title: Yakobo
text: Nuko rero mwaturanire ivyaha vyanyu, musengeranire kugira ngo mukire ingwara. Isengesho ry’umugororotsi ririmwo ububasha kandi rikora vyinshi.

title: 1 Petero
text: Muyikorere ingorane zanyu zose kuko irabitayeho.

title: 2 Petero
text: Ubushobozi bw’ubumana bwiwe bwaduhaye ivya nkenerwa vyose kugira ngo tubeho twubaha Imana biciye mu kumenya uwaduhamagaje ubwiza bwiwe n’ukugira neza kwiwe.

title: 1 Yohana
text: Twebwe dukunda kuko Imana yabanje kudukunda.

title: Yuda
text: Imana irashoboye kubazigama ngo ntimugwe no kubashikana imbere y’ubwiza bwayo mutagira ico mwogawa kandi munezerewe cane.

title: Ivyahishuwe
text: Izobahanagura amosozi yose ku maso yabo. Nta rupfu canke kugandara, nta kurira canke kubabara bizoba bikiriho, kuko ivya kera bizoba bikuweho.”
